blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–It appears that all’s well that ends well between Joshua Munzon and Titan Ultra. Munzon bared that he agreed to sign a three-year contract to remain with the Giant Risers after being the subject of trade rumors. And Munzon is pleased that the two sides were able to reach a deal. READ: PBA: Joshua Munzon tunes out trade rumors amid Titan woes “I’m happy,” Munzon said. “I’m happy that we were able to work it out and get on the same page.” The deal ends the saga that nearly ended before the break when Munzon was about to be dealt […]...
